title: All-electric aircraft is a game changer for transportation
summary: BETA’s all-electric ALIA CX300 aircraft took flight as part of the series of real-world flight operations conducted through uFLY, the Utah Department of Transportation’s (UDOT) multi-state initiative, in partnership with BETA Technologies and 47G.
